Execution checkpoint — incomplete, blocked on local game UI control, not an engine-impossibility finding.

Accepted foundation: MMR-9 installation/compiler inventory (Doctor positive and negative checks); MMR-10 pinned producer (fresh build, all 5 CTest targets, valid seeds 42/43, overflow rejection, exact same-seed replay); MMR-11 confirmed product contract and materialized profile. Root owns source and game. Reader does not ingest plan/scene bodies or compile gameplay; it never emits an activation receipt. C# surface probe is compiled but unexecuted. MMR-12/13/14/15/16/22/23 are NOT accepted.

Module installed only at D:/SteamLibrary/steamapps/common/Mount & Blade II Bannerlord/Modules/MNBL.ProceduralWorld. Diagnostic-only package: artifacts/fwgc-diagnostic-20261009-202443.zip; file hashes verified; contains no TaleWorlds binaries. This is NOT the playable campaign package. No generated campaign, navigation, wrapping, factions, naval gameplay, mission transition or save acceptance is claimed.

Runtime obstacle: first Bannerlord.Native launch crashed. Corrected Bannerlord.exe official-module launch reached the main menu (game 1.4.8.119303 / War Sails 1.2.8.119303). The native launch left a CSRSS-hosted crash prompt. No/Escape automation and termination of only the owned failed process/watchdog did not remove that prompt. After installing the mod, new game PID 17292 is waiting at Safe Mode; target clicks fail because the CSRSS dialog covers it. User was asked to click No. No files were uploaded; official files/saves were not modified. No module.log yet means managed mod loading is not established.

Resume: dismiss the stale crash dialog with No, then decline Safe Mode; inspect the actual game window and module.log; prove the diagnostic menu loads, execute seed42/43/cancel actions, then the main-thread surface probe. Read docs/runtime-capabilities.md and current run before continuing. Continue full saved epic after proving its capability gates; never silently substitute a static map. No workers, builds, tests or generator jobs remain running. The owned game test is pending. Work is on codex/fwgc-procedural-campaign, uncommitted; no foundation row check at a commit has been recorded yet.
